purpose: Regional pressure-interference screening; not calibrated for engineering design, seismic-risk assessment or permitting.

grid.type: continuous corner-point grid with spatially variable top and thickness
grid.vertical_layers: six equal subdivisions of each column's mapped gross interval
grid.corner_geometry: Cell-centre horizons are averaged to shared nodes; COORD/ZCORN faces are continuous between adjacent cells.
grid.inactive_rule: gross thickness below 5 m; resampling-edge property gaps use the nearest valid 500 m geological cell

property_model.source: Supplied Gassum well PHIE, Vshale and PERM_GEUS curves plus the DECODE 500 m NTG model
property_model.sampling: porosity depth trend evaluated at mapped mid-reservoir TVDSS; porosity-permeability transform evaluated per 2 km cell; NTG linearly sampled to the EarthVision nodes
property_model.reservoir_sample_rule: Top Gassum to Top Vinding samples with Vshale <= 0.40
property_model.display_colour_scale: One fixed P10-P90 range per geological property and reservoir; it does not rescale when the selected percentile changes.

boundary_conditions.lateral: West, east, south and north edge-cell pore volumes are multiplied by 1,000,000 as a large connected-aquifer pressure-sink approximation.

initial_conditions.temperature_method: regional median of mapped Gassum temperature

faults.representation: Supplied map traces rasterized to MULTX and MULTY faces and extended vertically through all six layers.
faults.shared_state_rule: Every fault uses the same selected state in a scenario.

schedule.post_injection_method: Each duration is an explicit OPM injection-and-shut-in schedule; pressure and SGAS continue to be simulated through year 60.

ensemble.property_design: L9 perturbations around every cell's mapped value

browser_combination_method: Alpha is scaled by its selected rate. Beta and Zeta use the incremental difference between their two-well unit response and Alpha-only response, scaled linearly by selected rate.

cross_section_export.section_rule: A user-defined A–A′ trace samples the nearest OPM columns and displays all six structural layers.

percentile_semantics: Geological layers show marginal property percentiles from the L9 input levels. Pressure and saturation layers show cell-wise output quantiles across all nine realizations. A displayed geological P10 map is therefore not asserted to be the unique realization producing pressure P10 at every cell.
limitations: The geological architecture and regional petrophysical fields are represented, but facies-scale heterogeneity and history matching are not.
The lateral boundary treatment is a screening approximation and has not been calibrated to regional aquifer support.
No coupled geomechanics, thermal coupling, stress-dependent fault behaviour or induced-seismicity probability is simulated.
The interface pressure constraint is user-configured and is not a calibrated fracture-pressure or fault-reactivation threshold.
This is a visualization proof of concept, not a validated pressure-capacity assessment; displayed headroom is not available storage capacity or a safe injection envelope.

The ensemble does not evaluate sensitivity to relative-permeability or capillary-pressure functions, structural uncertainty, aquifer strength, fault-specific properties, PVT, geomechanics or well performance.
Multi-project controls use linear unit-response superposition rather than a new fully coupled OPM run.
Only the five published injection durations are available; the interface does not interpolate between shut-in schedules.
Project-rate and multi-project controls still use unit-response scaling/superposition rather than a new nonlinear OPM run for every combination.
